📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough The changes implement remote deletion support in the filer by introducing a new helper method to delete remote objects corresponding to local entries, and integrating remote deletion attempts into both batch and single-entry deletion paths while propagating cluster-origin information. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Core Deletion Logic**
`weed/filer/filer_delete_entry.go`|Propagates `isFromOtherCluster` through recursive folder deletion calls. Adds remote deletion attempts for non-directory batch deletions (with warning logs on errors) and single-entry deletions before local metadata removal. Error propagation depends on `ignoreRecursiveError` flag.| |**Remote Deletion Helper**
`weed/filer/filer_lazy_remote.go`|Introduces new `maybeDeleteFromRemote` method that resolves remote storage clients and deletes remote objects or directories corresponding to local entries. Treats not-found errors as success and logs successful deletions at verbosity level 3.| |**Test Infrastructure & Coverage**
`weed/filer/filer_lazy_remote_test.go`|Extends `stubFilerStore` with in-memory KV operations, directory listing utilities, and delete-override tracking. Enhances `stubRemoteClient` to record remote delete/remove calls. Adds comprehensive test suite for `DeleteEntryMetaAndData` covering remote-only deletion, cluster-origin checks, mount scenarios, client resolution failures, error propagation, and recursive folder deletion.| ## Sequence Diagram ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Caller participant Filer participant RemoteClient participant LocalStore as Local Metadata Store Caller->>Filer: DeleteEntry(path, isFromOtherCluster) Filer->>Filer: Check if remote deletion needed
(not from another cluster) alt Should delete from remote Filer->>Filer: maybeDeleteFromRemote(entry) Filer->>Filer: Resolve remote storage client Filer->>RemoteClient: DeleteFile or RemoveDirectory RemoteClient-->>Filer: Success or error (not-found OK) end Filer->>LocalStore: Remove local metadata LocalStore-->>Filer: Confirmation Filer-->>Caller: Result (with remote error if any) ``` ## Estimated Code Review Effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes ## Poem > 🐰 A filer learns to clean both near and far, > Remote deletions shining like a star, > Metadata dances with the storage light, > No cluster conflicts—just clean and bright! ✨

# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
